消息传得比林川预想的还快。

签约仪式结束不到两个小时，张江那边的照片就已经在几个投资圈小群里传疯了。

副市长站台。

齐家的人露面。

九州创投拿下张江半导体材料项目排他协议。

北京来的中投信达，当场离场。

每一条单拎出来，都够圈里人嚼半天。

合在一起，就只剩四个字——

九州起飞。

当天晚上，顾城在新天地订了一桌日料。

包厢门一关，顾城把酒杯往桌上一放，笑得眼角纹都出来了。

“川子，今天这局，真是把我看爽了。”

旁边几个平时嘴上稳重的投资人，也都跟着举杯。

“以前只知道九州最近动作快，没想到林总后手这么深。”

“张江这盘子，能从中投信达嘴边抢下来，含金量太高了。”

“副市长亲自过去，这可不是普通站台。”

林川端着杯子，笑了笑。

“运气好。”

顾城当场翻了个白眼。

“你管这叫运气好？那我们这些人干脆别干投资了，回家买彩票算了。”

一桌人都笑了。

手机从坐下开始就没停过。

短信、微信、电话，一个接一个。

有祝贺的。

有试探合作的。

还有几个之前连回邮件都慢半拍的机构负责人，这会儿语气热得像多年老友。

措辞各异，意思却高度统一——

林总，牛逼。

晚上十一点半，林川回到酒店。

第二天上午九点。

苏晚棠抱着一摞打印好的清单走进林川办公室。

她今天穿了一身浅灰色职业套装，头发挽在脑后，脸上没什么多余表情，但眼底明显带着一点压不住的兴奋。

“二十四小时之内，九州对外联络邮箱收到了十七份正式商务合作意向函。”

她把清单放到桌上。

“这是我初筛过的。”

林川拿起来扫了一眼。

苏晚棠继续说：“其中三份来自此前完全没有交集的长三角头部PE，两份来自产业资本，一份来自地方引导基金。还有六七份资质不够的，被前台直接挡回去了。”

林川笑了笑。

九州以前主动递出去的名片，别人未必愿意接。

现在倒好。

风一吹，泼天的富贵自己往门口撞。

这就是资本圈。

你没赢的时候，所有人都在观望。

你赢了一次，所有人都会假装自己早就看好你。

林川把清单合上，没有急着表态。

“先放着，回头让周明远再过一遍。”

苏晚棠点头。

“明白。现在外面热度太高，主动靠过来的，不一定都是朋友。”

张虎在九州待了半个多月。

从第一天进门被办公室装修晃得眼花，到后来被叶知秋按着学财务报表，被周明远逼着看行业报告，天天脑子像被塞进了搅拌机。

累是真累。

但也是真有奔头。

以前他觉得林川牛，是兄弟发达了。

现在他才慢慢意识到，林川干的事，不是开公司这么简单。

这是在一桌全是老狐狸的牌局里，硬生生把肉给抢下来。

同一天。

陆家嘴某栋写字楼顶层。

顾清烟合上简报，推到桌角。

她拿起手机，点开林川的对话框。

上一条消息还停留在她约林川吃饭，被林川拒绝的那句。

聊天框里干干净净。

The news spread faster than Lin Chuan expected.

Less than two hours after the signing ceremony, Zhang Jiang’s photos had already gone viral in several investment circles.

The deputy mayor's platform.

People from the Qi family showed up.

Jiuzhou Venture Capital won an exclusive agreement for Zhangjiang semiconductor materials project.

CIC Cinda, who came from Beijing, left the scene on the spot.

Every single item taken out is enough for people in the circle to chew on for a long time.

Taken together, there are only four words left——

Kyushu takes off.

That night, Gu Cheng ordered a table of Japanese food at Xintiandi.

As soon as the box door closed, Gu Cheng put the wine glass on the table and laughed so hard that lines appeared at the corners of his eyes.

"Kawako, I really enjoyed today's game."

Several investors nearby, who usually spoke calmly, also raised their glasses.

"I only knew that Jiuzhou was moving very fast recently, but I didn't expect Mr. Lin to be so deep behind the scenes."

"Zhang Jiang's plate is so valuable that it can be snatched from Zhongtou Xinda's mouth."

"The deputy mayor went there in person. This is no ordinary platform."

Lin Chuan held the cup and smiled.

"Good luck."

Gu Cheng rolled his eyes on the spot.

"You call this good luck? Then we people should just stop investing and go home and buy lottery tickets."

Everyone at the table laughed.

The phone hasn’t stopped since I sat down.

Text messages, WeChat, phone calls, one after another.

There are congratulations.

Some are trying to cooperate.

There are also several agency heads who were slow to reply to emails before, but now their tone of voice is as warm as old friends.

The wording is different, but the meaning is highly unified——

Mr. Lin, awesome.

At half past eleven in the evening, Lin Chuan returned to the hotel.

Nine o'clock in the morning the next day.

Su Wantang walked into Lin Chuan's office holding a stack of printed lists.

She was wearing a light gray professional suit today, with her hair tied back. There was no extraneous expression on her face, but there was obviously a little bit of uncontrollable excitement in her eyes.

"Within twenty-four hours, Jiuzhou's external liaison mailbox received 17 formal letters of intent for business cooperation."

She put the list on the table.

"This is what I first screened."

Lin Chuan picked it up and glanced at it.

Su Wantang continued: "Three of them came from leading PE companies in the Yangtze River Delta that had no previous connections, two came from industrial capital, and one came from local guidance funds. There were also six or seven that were not qualified enough and were directly blocked by the front office."

Lin Chuan smiled.

Others may not be willing to accept the business cards Jiuzhou took the initiative to hand out in the past.

It's better now.

When the wind blows, Fugui hits the door by himself.

This is the capital circle.

When you don't win, everyone is watching.

If you win once, everyone will pretend that they have always favored you.

Lin Chuan closed the list and did not rush to express his position.

"Let it go for now, then let Zhou Mingyuan go through it again."

Su Wantang nodded.

"I understand. It's too hot outside now, and those who come over may not necessarily be friends."

Zhang Hu stayed in Jiuzhou for more than half a month.

From the first day he walked in and was dazzled by the office decoration, to later being forced to learn financial statements by Ye Zhiqiu, and forced to read industry reports by Zhou Mingyuan, his brain felt like it was being stuffed into a blender every day.

Tired, really tired.

But it’s also really ambitious.

In the past, he thought that Lin Chuanniu was a brother who became prosperous.

Now he slowly realized that what Lin Chuan was doing was not as simple as opening a company.

This is at a poker table full of old foxes, who forcefully snatched away the meat.

same day.

The top floor of an office building in Lujiazui.

Gu Qingyan closed the briefing and pushed it to the corner of the table.

She picked up her phone and clicked on Lin Chuan's dialog box.

The last message still stopped at the sentence where she asked Lin Chuan to have dinner, but Lin Chuan refused.

The chat box is clean.
